title: Unique Yeasty Portuguese Dough Fritters
description: A traditional Portuguese dessert featuring marjoram and candy, these yeasty dough fritters are kid-friendly and nut-free, cooked to perfection on a salt block.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and marjoram.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat the salt block to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into balls.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a few candy pieces in the center.
Fold the dough over the candy and seal the edges.
Cook the fritters on the salt block for 5 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
